source.required_inputs: Only pinned retained metadata/human bytes, frozen source identity/canonicalization helpers and externally pinned old feature-only reconstruction evidence. No NB/T models, old predictions or additional human labels; selected style parsing skips fold4 before vote extraction.

evaluation_aggregates.attribution: Music Technology Group; Bogdanov, Won, Tovstogan, Porter and Serra (2019), The MTG-Jamendo Dataset for Automatic Music Tagging; Music Classification Annotations documentation

prevalence.note: Query prevalence is artist-equal. Gallery prevalence is the query-weighted mean of within-fold artist-equal gallery means, not unique-gallery pooled. Track counts are pooled support only, not weights; galleries listed once per fold.
